name: singlet_spatial_domains_single_slice_domains
title: Assign spatial domains on one section
description: Assigns each spot or cell on one tissue section to a spatial domain from its expression, 2D coordinates and, optionally, an aligned H&E image. Methods: leiden_joint (default; Leiden on a mix of expression and spatial kNN graphs), potts_mean_field and potts_gibbs (Potts-t mixtures that also return per-unit label probabilities), spagcn (graph convolution with a clustering layer; histology needs an image). Needs obsm/spatial and obsm/X_pca (or layers/counts) for one section; writes obs/<output_key>, the graph and parameters, probabilities for the Potts methods and an embedding for spagcn; potts_gibbs and spagcn may return queued. Do NOT use it for several sections jointly (use the multi-slice task), to choose the number of domains or the spatial scale (use the domain-number task), to score labels against annotation, or to assign cell types.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: leiden_joint: Leiden on a mixed expression and spatial graph. potts_mean_field and potts_gibbs: Potts-t mixture with probabilities. spagcn: graph convolution with clustering layer.

n_domains.description: Target number of domains. Resolution search for leiden_joint and spagcn; fixes K for Potts methods. Null: default resolution, or ICL selection of K.

output_key.description: Prefix of all written members, for example obs/<output_key> and obsp/<output_key>_graph.

n_pcs.description: Principal components used. Null: all of obsm/X_pca for leiden_joint, 50 for spagcn, 15 for Potts methods.

n_hvgs.description: Highly variable genes for PCA; used only when obsm/X_pca is absent.

graph_type.description: Spatial graph: k nearest neighbours, or Delaunay for generic positions.

n_neighbors.description: Spatial neighbours k; 6 is the Squidpy grid default. Ignored for delaunay.

expr_n_neighbors.description: Neighbours in the expression graph (Scanpy default).

spatial_weight.description: Weight lambda of the spatial graph in the joint graph.

resolution.description: Leiden resolution; used when n_domains is null.

refine_labels.description: Apply the SpaGCN refinement rule to the final labels.

potts.description: Options for methods potts_mean_field and potts_gibbs.

gamma.description: Degree-normalised Potts strength. Null: 3 on a hexagonal lattice, 2 otherwise (BayesSpace defaults).

k_max.description: Largest K tried by ICL when n_domains is null.

mcmc_iterations.description: Gibbs sweeps for potts_gibbs; must exceed burn_in.

burn_in.description: Gibbs sweeps discarded before summarising; below mcmc_iterations.

image_key.description: uns/spatial key of the H&E image; non-null adds the colour coordinate. Null: coordinates only.

histology_patch.description: Patch size beta for averaging colour around each unit.

histology_scale.description: Scale alpha of the colour coordinate.

p.description: Target mean summed neighbour weight that calibrates the length scale.

lr.description: Learning rate of the training loop.

refine_labels.description: Apply the SpaGCN refinement rule to the final labels.

seed.description: Random seed for initialisation, Gibbs sampling and spagcn training.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when the method has a CUDA path and memory allows. leiden_joint runs on CPU.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing labels.

overwrite.description: Replace existing members with the same output_key instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/spatial_domain and uns/spatial_domain/params. The probability and embedding members appear only for the methods that produce them. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs; never raw matrices.

n_domains.description: Number of distinct domain labels written.

domain_counts.description: Units per domain label, keyed by label.

graph.description: Size of the graph used: n_nodes, n_edges and mean_degree.

k_selection.description: ICL value by K when the Potts methods selected K; null otherwise.

mean_max_probability.description: Mean of the maximum label probability for the Potts methods; null for leiden_joint and spagcn.

parameters.description: Effective parameter values after resolving null defaults.

length_scale.description: SpaGCN length scale l; null for other methods.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
